title: Наборы протоколов
description: Как сетевые протоколы эволюционировали с течением времени? Что такое стек сетевых протоколов? Что такое стек TCP/IP

produces.objective: Assign common protocols (TCP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, IP, ICMP, Ethernet) and services (routing, messaging) to the layers of the TCP/IP model, and trace which layer processes a received frame's contents after the Ethernet information is removed.

measurement.passes_when: All embedded questions answered correctly (100%, unlimited attempts): TCP/IP layers and their protocols, ICMP error feedback, de-encapsulation order.
